description: Unofficial fan-art Toru Oikawa companion inspired by Haikyu!!. Independently drawn school-volleyball animation with a soft ball, a small abstract tactics board, shoulder warm-ups and jersey straightening, and original running and low setter-practice jump cycles. Youthful number 1 white-and-teal sportswear is retained; props and choreography are original adaptations. No official affiliation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
